biggest_catch: The friend must open a NEW membership - referrals of existing members earn nothing - and the $500 yearly cap means only your first 20 referrals pay out.
catches: $25 per referred member, up to $500 per calendar year (20 successful referrals).
Referred person must open a new membership and cannot already be an existing member.
Payout deposited to the referrer's primary savings account within 5 days of the new member's account opening.
Accounts must be in good standing; referrer must be 18+; HACU employees do not qualify.
Referral payout is miscellaneous income, may be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC.
Offer subject to change without notice; membership eligibility applies (healthcare associates of select employers, community charter residents, or CU4Kids donors).
